name: Smižany (Slovakia)
description: White and blue: the hoist half chequered white and blue in two rows, the fly half white with a blue band across the middle, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature S-33/1992.

features.role: hoist half chequered white and blue, fly half white with a central blue band
